correctness.rationale: A complete induction identifies the precise alternating row/column successor-signature classes. The modal partition at the next round equals the product of these row/column classes refined by the known single-bit truth value, and exactly one middle block is bichromatic until all n squared cells separate. Standard finite modal characteristic formulas then show that the depth-t definable Boolean algebra has exactly 2 to the power r_t elements. The checker verifies all intermediate profiles for 2<=n<=60, the selectors for n<=30, and direct Boolean modal closure for n=2,3,4. These finite tests supplement rather than replace the general proof.

value.rationale: A natural exact invariant of the classical two-agent finite staircase is computed completely at all modal depths and all grid sizes. The result supplies the optimal nesting depth needed to define every state, and an exact quadratic sequence of intermediate modal types or exponential sequence of depth-bounded Boolean-definable sets. The alternating-end signature theorem explains why the transition occurs and provides a benchmark for modal expressivity and bisimulation-refinement stratification. It is not an arbitrary finite cutoff or a restatement of known one-generation.
